To prepare for an ECG, please note that no fasting is required. However, avoid applying body lotion or cream on your chest, arms, and legs on the day of the test, as electrodes need direct skin contact. Wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing that is easy to remove, and remove jewellery from your wrists and ankles before the test. Also, try to avoid vigorous exercise in the 30 minutes before the test. If you have any further questions, please call our reception or visit the front desk for more information.
